_about: Owner rulings of 5 Oct 2026 (GRADER-CORE-1 spec WHY, rulings (2)-(7)) applied to the examiner-verified expectations (data/verify/items.verified.json + data/supplement/items.supplement.json). The loader (lib/data.cjs applyRepins) applies each row ONLY if the current value still equals `old`, and throws otherwise, so a later edit to the verified set cannot be silently overwritten. Rows with `kind: settled` change no value: the ruling settles a contest the audit left open in favour of the verified value, so `contested` becomes false. Rows with `kind: added` add a field the verified set did not carry (v2-only fields are scored only on responses produced with acceptsV2). Cases the rulings do not settle keep their verified value and are listed under `unsettled`.

rulings.2: A miscopied value is penalised ONCE (silly); the work after it earns ECF marks.
rulings.3: A wrongly formed equation then solved correctly loses the forming marks and earns the solving marks (ECF). 'Departure = zero' is kept ONLY for answering a different problem or using an invalid method.
rulings.4: Crossed-out / withdrawn work is not assessed.
rulings.5: No deduction for missing state symbols.
rulings.6: Maths units follow the question's scheme; a silent scheme means no deduction. Science keeps unit deductions.
rulings.7: Mistake type: copied wrongly = silly, performed wrongly = calculation, method misunderstood = conceptual, CBSE format only = presentation, unattempted = no type.

repins.basis: The times are reversed (480/x - 480/(x-8) = 3): a wrongly FORMED equation for the same problem, not a different problem and not an invalid method. The forming marks (step 2, 1.5) are lost; x^2 - 8x + 1280 = 0 is correctly derived from the student's own equation and earns the solving mark (step 3, 1.5, ECF). Steps 4-5 stay 0 because (x - 40)(x + 32) is not a factorisation of the student's quadratic (fudged), so the final 40 km/h is not 'solved correctly'. This equals the CBSE-instruction-10 alternative the verifier recorded (2/5).

The P = V/I lines are explicitly withdrawn by the student and are not assessed: 4/4, no mistake type, nothing for Mistake Intelligence. App case law 2 (3.5/4) is overruled.

BUILDER JUDGEMENT, flagged: the question says 'translate ... and then balance them'; the student wrote correct skeletal equations and did not attempt balancing at all (no coefficient anywhere). That is a requested sub-task left wholly unattempted, exactly the principle the verified set applied to GS-M22-a ('verify your answer' not attempted -> no type). Ruling 7 'unattempted = no type' supplies the principle the verifier said was missing. Marks unchanged (1/2).

GRADER-CORE-1 spec section 3: GS-M13-a (a truly illegible page) must be DECLINED by both graders (couldNotRead / honest decline), never a fabricated 0. Scored as m13_declined over every run of every surface.

unsettled.why: The balanced equation was asked for and written unbalanced while (c)(i) balances correctly: not 'copied wrongly', arguably not 'method misunderstood', and not an unattempted sub-task (the equation was written). The rulings do not decide between conceptual and a slip; the verified value is kept.
'clotting cells' for 'platelets': whether a missing CBSE technical term is 'CBSE format only' (presentation) or a knowledge gap (conceptual) is not decided by the rulings; the verified value is kept.
Not contested on marks: the official MS 2025 Q35 erratum (class width 3 vs 2) has no defensible alternative; the golden set follows the correct mathematics.

noMathsUnitCase: No golden Maths case omits a unit, so ruling 6's Maths half has no golden case yet (recorded, not invented).
